screen18-a1.glyph: dimmed grey strip along the right screen edge, no symbol of its own
screen18-a1.description: dimmed grey strip along the right edge beside the open side panel; the X glyph of the incognito screen beneath shows through it
screen18-a1.visible_text: none; the only mark inside it is the dimmed X glyph belonging to the covered screen
screen18-a1.accessibility_text_consulted: content_desc "Close navigation menu" — read only to know what to tap for and watch for; not used in the verdict
screen18-a1.convention_relied_on: tapping the dimmed area outside a side panel to close it is an Android convention; the X visible inside the strip is the close convention — my reading, confidence medium
screen18-a1.initial_rationale: the strip has no face of its own; the X showing through belongs to the covered incognito screen, so the strip may be read as that control

test_cases.precondition: side panel open over the incognito chat screen
test_cases.action: tap exactly on the dimmed X inside the strip
test_cases.confirms_if: the tap does something a user reading the X as 'close' would not expect
test_cases.overturns_if: the tap closes the thing covering the screen
test_cases.observed_result: the side panel closed; the incognito chat stayed open underneath. What closed was the panel, which is what an X over an open panel promises

screen18-a1.deciding_evidence: the only glyph inside the strip is an X, and tapping it closed the open panel — a close glyph doing a close; the borrowed glyph did not mislead here as it does on the non-incognito drawer

screen18-a2.description: large word 'Claude' at the top of the side panel
screen18-a2.visible_text: "Claude" (the product's name, set as a title)
screen18-a2.accessibility_text_consulted: content_desc "Claude" — read only to know what to tap for and watch for; not used in the verdict
screen18-a2.initial_rationale: the visible text is the product's name; it reads as a title, not an action, and says nothing about what pressing it does
screen18-a2.deciding_evidence: same control as screen2-a2 (identical appearance, words and position in the same repeated state); tested once there and the verdict carried: the title is actionable and starts a new chat, which the product name gives no hint of
screen18-a2.recommendation: make the title non-interactive, or label the action it performs (e.g. 'Home' / 'New chat')

screen18-a3.description: 'Chats' row with a speech-bubbles glyph in the side panel
screen18-a3.accessibility_text_consulted: talkback_label "Chats" — read only to know what to tap for and watch for; not used in the verdict
screen18-a3.initial_rationale: plain word naming a destination: the list of your chats
screen18-a3.deciding_evidence: same control as screen2-a3 (identical appearance, words and position in the same repeated state); tested once there and the verdict carried: opened the Chats list it names

screen18-a4.description: 'Projects' row with a stacked-tray glyph in the side panel
screen18-a4.accessibility_text_consulted: talkback_label "Projects" — read only to know what to tap for and watch for; not used in the verdict
screen18-a4.deciding_evidence: same control as screen2-a4 (identical appearance, words and position in the same repeated state); tested once there and the verdict carried: opened the Projects screen, which also explains what a project is

screen18-a5.description: 'Code' row with a </> glyph in the side panel
screen18-a5.accessibility_text_consulted: talkback_label "Code" — read only to know what to tap for and watch for; not used in the verdict
screen18-a5.initial_rationale: 'Code' alone does not say whether this writes code, shows code, or opens a coding tool; a first-time user cannot tell what they get
screen18-a5.deciding_evidence: same control as screen2-a5 (identical appearance, words and position in the same repeated state); tested once there and the verdict carried: the row leads to a paid-product upgrade page; neither the product nor the paywall is conveyed by the single word 'Code'
screen18-a5.recommendation: name the destination, e.g. 'Claude Code (coding assistant) — Pro'

screen18-a6.description: 'Artifacts' row with a shapes glyph in the side panel
screen18-a6.accessibility_text_consulted: talkback_label "Artifacts" — read only to know what to tap for and watch for; not used in the verdict
screen18-a6.initial_rationale: 'Artifacts' is product jargon; a first-time user does not know what an artifact is
screen18-a6.deciding_evidence: same control as screen2-a6 (identical appearance, words and position in the same repeated state); tested once there and the verdict carried: neither the row nor the screen it opens explains the term
screen18-a6.recommendation: rename or caption it in plain words, e.g. 'Artifacts — documents, code and designs Claude made for you'

screen18-a7.glyph: orange filled circle containing the letters AC
screen18-a7.description: orange circle with the letters 'AC' at the bottom-left of the side panel
screen18-a7.accessibility_text_consulted: content_desc "Ally Cooper, Settings" — read only to know what to tap for and watch for; not used in the verdict
screen18-a7.convention_relied_on: a circle with the user's initials is an established account/profile avatar convention leading to account settings — my reading, confidence medium
screen18-a7.initial_rationale: initials avatar convention for 'your account'; exemption pending the behavioural test
screen18-a7.deciding_evidence: same control as screen2-a7 (identical appearance, words and position in the same repeated state); tested once there and the verdict carried: the initials avatar opened the account settings, as the avatar convention promises

screen18-a8.description: black pill with a plus and the words 'New chat'
screen18-a8.accessibility_text_consulted: talkback_label "New chat" — read only to know what to tap for and watch for; not used in the verdict
screen18-a8.deciding_evidence: same control as screen2-a8 (identical appearance, words and position in the same repeated state); tested once there and the verdict carried: the visible words say exactly what it does; no test required
